body:
I've prepared draft #3307 as an evidence-backed review candidate for the decision record in #3140, using `s-core_sw_fabric` implementation experience. It is offered for incorporation into the existing proposal.

@aryansingh0012 @praveen-ltts, the proposal preserves `dec_rec__infra__ai_sdlc_tooling`, keeps it `proposed`, and uses the current infrastructure folder and native decision-record fields. It addresses the review questions about existing S-CORE process ownership, lifecycle loopbacks, bounded agent context, actual native use, and qualification limits.

The evidence packet includes revision-bound source, historical passing and failed checks, rendering-proxy measurements, and primary-source captures for all eight options in #3115. Spec Kit development experience is separated from documentation-only research on the alternatives. Real-task comparative performance, production trust and ASIL-B qualification remain open.

Please review whether this bounded pilot assessment is the right scope for completing the tooling decision record, and which comparative packaging/native-task pilots you require before accepting it. The candidate can be incorporated into #3140; its existing identifier and proposed status are preserved.


- [Native draft PR #3307](https://github.com/eclipse-score/score/pull/3307)
- [Portable evidence and source packet](https://github.com/Eclipse-SDV-Hackathon-Chapter-Four/Thinking_CAPs/tree/contrib/score-ai-sdlc-3115-evidence/contributions/issues/eclipse-score/score/3115)
- [Fresh native verification and full logs](https://github.com/Eclipse-SDV-Hackathon-Chapter-Four/Thinking_CAPs/tree/contrib/score-ai-sdlc-3115-evidence/contributions/issues/eclipse-score/score/3115/upstream-preparation)

Validation against main `fdc04f75a2251fcd8cbfd01585fba158c4e09756`: the corrected candidate adds one proposed DR and leaves all 925 existing needs unchanged. Native schema validation reports zero warnings. Baseline and candidate `//:docs_check` both fail on the same existing lifecycle link warning at `docs/features/lifecycle/architecture/index.rst:75` (`logic_arc_int__lifecycle__report_running_if` fulfils unknown `feat_req__lifecycle__switch_run_targets`); there are no new candidate documentation warnings. `//:docs` renders the candidate but fails on that inherited warning. Native copyright/configuration and candidate whitespace checks pass. Documentation CI remains unresolved, and the PR remains a draft.
